html:
French Madagascar was the colony that France ruled on the island of Madagascar from 1896 to 1960.

French troops took the capital, Antananarivo, in 1895. The next year France declared the island a colony. In 1897 it ended the Merina monarchy and sent the last queen, Ranavalona III, into exile in Algeria. The governor Joseph Gallieni crushed resistance and set up forced labour for roads and plantations.

  • 1942: British forces took the island from the Vichy French during World War II.
  • 1947: the Malagasy Uprising against French rule was put down with great force. Estimates of the dead run from tens of thousands upward.
  • 1960: independence as the Malagasy Republic.

The poet Jean-Joseph Rabearivelo wrote in these years, in French and Malagasy.
sum: French Madagascar was the colony that France ruled on the island of Madagascar from 1896 to 1960.
